verdict.rationale: Ollama's own marketing states directly that it offers dedicated capacity so throughput holds up when several agents run at once, and its pricing page lists running multiple models concurrently. These are only single-line claims. There are no technical docs on how capacity is reserved, which plans or deployment (local vs cloud) it applies to, or any measured concurrent throughput. Missing for 10: technical documentation of the capacity reservation and concurrency mechanism, scope by plan or deployment, and independent or hands-on benchmarks of steady throughput under concurrent load.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know the runtime reserves dedicated capacity so throughput holds steady when multiple agents or sessions issue requests concurrently

citations.quote: Dedicated capacity so throughput holds up when you are running several agents at once.
